title: Grid Garden
description: A calm little puzzle about growing a garden. Tapping one tile changes its neighbours: find the pattern that makes every flower bloom. Four hand-made, solvable gardens, undo, and gentle hints. No timer or account needed.
controls: Click or tap a tile to change it and its orthogonal neighbours.
Tab into the garden, move focus with arrow keys, then use Space or Enter.
Undo reverses a move. Hint highlights a useful tile. Reset starts the current garden again.
